text:
ashley: Quick q — thinking about UX for 'sidecar tokens' in Console. idea: create a token card that's scoped to routes/models and shows routing policy + quota + rollout status. where should we surface routing policy details without overwhelming users?
ben: Love the idea. big Q: show effective routing policy on the card or in an expanded panel? per-token badge vs hover? also privacy: don't leak tenant-internal route names to other orgs.
maria: I think compact badges on the card (region, model-family, quota) and a detailed drawer for advanced policy. preview should show primary route + fallback route. Example preview object:
```json
{
  "scope": ["route:write:generate", "model:openai/gpt4"],
  "routing_policy": "latency_prefer, fallback=cheaper-variant",
  "quota": "10M tokens/mo"
}
```
kevin: +1. Telemetry should be first-class on the token card: last 7d usage sparkline + cost delta if token switches to quantized model. small inline estimate is enough.
lee: One more: rollouts. If a token is pinned to a canary model version we need to show rollout pct and automatic fallback behavior. users expect "active" vs "canary(10%)" state.
ben: UX note: hide raw policy DSL for non-admins. show friendly summary and an "Advanced" toggle to reveal JSON. also add a tooltip for what "fallback" means.
maria: edge-case: export/backup of tokens — CSV should snapshot effective-permissions and active routes at export time (so audits match).
dev-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag perms-sidecarTokens = on for 10% tenants, canary window 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
ashley: cool, action items: mockups (maria), API shape + sample payloads (kevin), telemetry events + event names (ben). i'll write acceptance criteria and privacy checklist.
kevin: quick API sketch:
```http
POST /api/v1/tokens
{
  "name": "svc-frontend",
  "scope": ["route:invoke"],
  "route_id": "r_abc123",
  "pin_model_version": "gpt-neo-2.7b-q4",
  "rollout": {"type": "canary", "pct": 10}
}
```
ben: question re: tenancy — tokens should inherit tenant-level restrictions (e.g., Dedicated tenants can't pick hosted-only routes). UI should gray-out incompatible route options.
ashley: noted. we'll include a small compatibility indicator on the token edit flow. reconvene after mocks. :eyes:
